description: This file contains utility functions for input detection, MIME type mapping, JSON type mapping, skill name generation, input schema creation, port availability checking, and result serialization, specifically for an agent framework. It defines the AgentUtils class with static methods to support various helper functionalities.

classes.name: AgentUtils
classes.description: Utility functions extracted from Agent class for better code organization.

methods.name: detect_input_type
methods.description: Detects the type of input data (e.g., URL, file, bytes, dict, list, etc.) based on content and structure.

methods.name: is_image_url
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to an image based on its extension.

methods.name: is_audio_url
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to an audio file based on its extension.

methods.name: get_mime_type
methods.description: Returns MIME type string based on file extension.

methods.name: map_json_type_to_python
methods.description: Maps JSON schema types to corresponding Python types.

methods.name: generate_skill_name
methods.description: Generates a valid Python function name for an MCP skill based on server alias and tool name.

methods.name: create_input_schema_from_mcp_tool
methods.description: Creates a Pydantic input schema class from MCP tool definition.

methods.name: is_port_available
methods.description: Checks if a network port is available for use.

methods.name: serialize_result
methods.description: Serializes complex objects into JSON-serializable formats.
